cc:Work.dc:title: Metropolis Purdue layers and IPsec overlays
cc:Work.dc:description: Six routers and 21 switches from the selected dataset. Dashed IPsec VTI overlays are configured in the repository; live negotiation is unverified.

g.text: Declared configuration, not live verification. 47 cabled downstream devices; MET-DEBUG-DMZ-01 is intentionally uncabled and omitted.
